import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data from the CSV file
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Convert transaction_type column to categorical type
data['transaction_type'] = data['transaction_type'].astype('category')

# Create a bar chart to display the distribution of transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Types')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.clf()

# Create a box plot to display the distribution of amounts by transaction type
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Amounts by Transaction Type')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Amount')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, mode='append')
plt.clf()

# Create a histogram to display the distribution of amounts
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(data['amount'], bins=20)
plt.title('Distribution of Amounts')
plt.xlabel('Amount')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, mode='append')
plt.clf()

# Create a bar chart to display the distribution of hours of day

plt.title('Distribution of Hours of Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
